author: Tim
text: Look No Further! ONLY place to call in the greater Montgomery area. Veteran and military friendly, great staff, and easy to work with. Only company that called back and came out. Nichole was friendly and worked with me and kept me informed of their schedule. Russ, Dontaves, and Lewis were professional, informative , friendly, and very knowledgeable about my situation. They worked with me get the job done right and quickly. I have them in my contacts under favorites! We will use them again and I highly recommend you call them for all your septic needs!

author: Joe Meherg
text: Sandy and Kennedy do it all.  They install the septic system and then pump your septic tank.  Great service and pricing...

author: Christian Noftz
text: These are some of the best folks I've dealt with in any field.  The owners, office people, and the guys who do the actual pumping are all fantastic.  Friendly, polite, and efficient.  They've done a great job on multiple occasions.  Highly recommended.

author: Zach Horr
text: BSKC was great to work with. They came and pumped/inspected my septic tank quickly and efficiently. They explained everything that they saw and were very friendly. There was a small scheduling issue (out of their control) but there customer service was excellent and worked hard to get my service rescheduled. I would definitely recommend and I will use again.

author: crystal hatcher
text: Highly recommend BSKC Soil & Septic Services, LLC!!!!  Needed field lines replaced.  Services were reasonably priced.  Sandy was professional, knowledgable and handled the service in a timely manner.  Shout out to Russ Downs and Dontaves Smoke for doing an excellent job!!!!  We will be using them from now on.
